title: context-budget fires on every skill-file run due to pre-existing oversize
description: spec.skill.md (535L), run.skill.md (602L), and fix_signal.skill.md (481L) were already over the 300-line context-budget threshold before this run. Any run that writes to these files will fail context-budget regardless of the delta added. The minimum-diff hard rule prevents in-run refactoring.
proposed_resolution: Dedicate a spec run targeting only skill file size reduction. Alternatively add a context-budget exception mechanism that measures only the lines added by a run rather than the total file size.
